name: DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake

achievements.name: Tantegel Audience
achievements.detail: Speak with the king in Tantegel Castle and accept the quest to stop the Dragonlord.

achievements.name: Gwaelin Rescued
achievements.detail: Free Princess Gwaelin from captivity and see her returned to safety.

achievements.name: Rainbow Drop
achievements.detail: Obtain the Rainbow Drop and open the path to the Dragonlord's castle.

achievements.name: Erdrick's Sword
achievements.detail: Take Erdrick's sword from the Dragonlord's castle and equip it.

achievements.name: Dragonlord Felled
achievements.detail: Defeat the Dragonlord and free Alefgard from his army.

achievements.name: Midenhall Embarks
achievements.detail: Leave Midenhall after the attack on Moonbrooke and begin the second quest.

achievements.name: Cannock Prince
achievements.detail: Find the Prince of Cannock and have him join the party.

achievements.name: Moonbrooke Princess
achievements.detail: Find the Princess of Moonbrooke and welcome her magic into the party.

achievements.name: Cannock Princess
achievements.detail: Recruit the Princess of Cannock so the four Scions travel together.

achievements.name: Open Waters
achievements.detail: Gain a ship and sail to a land beyond the starting shores.

achievements.name: Hargon Halted
achievements.detail: Defeat Hargon and stop the sorcerer who brought ruin to Moonbrooke.

achievements.name: Final Calamity
achievements.detail: Win the last battle of the second quest.
